title: Should You Replace Old Windows Before Selling Your Home? Here’s the Truth...
description:
Thinking about replacing old aluminum windows before selling your home? Here’s the real deal it might make your home look better, but you likely won’t get your money back. In most cases, it's smarter to let buyers request it during the repair negotiation. Watch this before spending thousands on upgrades that won’t boost your ROI.
